notes: Company snapshot: mid-market productivity SaaS (workflow automation) building smart search + suggestions inside product.
Interest path: evaluating Hosted API for fast iteration -> likely move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC after successful POC.
Primary objective: improve search relevancy via a reranking layer. They currently return candidate lists from ElasticSearch and want to run Redwood rerank endpoint to rescore/offline evaluate.

Tech preferences: prefer open model family (Llama-2/Redwood-verified variants) for cost control; open to cross-encoder style models for rerank scoring. Want quantized variants for Dedicated to reduce cost.

Performance targets: p95 <= 120ms for rerank endpoint (95th latency target with batch size 1 for UX flows), throughput target ~100-150 reqs/sec during business hours, offline scoring job ~5M docs/week.
Cost sensitivity: moderate — will trade some latency for lower per-token cost. Primary procurement concern is committed pricing for Dedicated vs. pay-as-you-go hosted rates.
Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML integration mandatory, audit logs and KMS integration requested. Data residency: prefer US only for now (legal will confirm).

POC scope (agreed): 2-week hosted POC using Redwood Hosted API for rerank endpoint + evaluation harness, deliverables: A/B metrics (NDCG@10, MRR), qualitative review sets, cost delta report. If metrics hit targets, run 2-week Dedicated smoke test in VPC.
POC success metrics discussed: +12% NDCG@10 over baseline, p95 latency <120ms, per-query cost reduction target 20% vs current in-house pipeline when on Dedicated with quantization suggestions.
Recent quote from head of search (call 2/25): 'We want predictable tails — can't have spikes during enterprise demos. If Redwood nails p95 and costs look good we can push to commit.'

Eng notes: SE run initial offline scoring with sample eval set (20k queries) using Redwood Hosted API — saw promising ranking lift but higher token usage on long doc contexts; SE recommended prefix caching + candidate truncation to reduce cost.
Billing/procurement: finance requested example Dedicated commitment pricing for 12/24-month terms; AE to deliver pricing deck and comparison sheet by 3/18.
Legal: sent security questionnaire on 3/2 (drive link above). waiting on data residency clause amendment.

requirements_summary: Workload: synchronous rerank for UX flows + nightly offline scoring for reindexing

Operational: canary rollouts, deterministic version pinning for models, and ability to run A/B between hosted and dedicated models
